recipe.title: Vegan Pasta with Tofu and Cream
ingredients: 100 ml coconut cream or cashew cream
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions.
Cube the tofu and fry it until golden brown.
Add the coconut cream or cashew cream to the tofu and stir well.
Combine the cooked pasta with the tofu mixture.
changes: Replaced chicken breast with 150 g of firm tofu.
Replaced dairy cream with 100 ml of coconut cream or cashew cream.
warnings: Make sure to use firm tofu for the best texture.
Check for dairy-free labels on coconut or cashew cream to ensure they are vegan.
